```{r}
#| warning: false
#| message: false

#load your libraries in this chunk
library(tidyverse)
dat_multi <- read_csv("https://github.com/byuidatascience/data_fivethirtyeight_starwars/raw/master/survey_multiresponse_questions.csv")
dat_single <- read_csv("https://github.com/byuidatascience/data_fivethirtyeight_starwars/raw/master/survey_oneresponse_questions.csv")
dat_wide <- read_csv("https://github.com/byuidatascience/data_fivethirtyeight_starwars/raw/master/survey_wide_all.csv")

```

```{r}
View(dat_multi)
View(dat_single)
View(dat_wide)

```

```{r}
single <- dat_single %>% 
  rename(
    ID = respondentid,
    exposure = seen_any6,
    fan = fan_yn,
    expanded = fan_expanded,
    startrek = fan_startrek) %>% 
  select(c(1,7,8,9,10,11)) %>% 
  drop_na(shot_first)

View(single)



wide <- dat_wide %>% 
  rename(
    ID = respondentid,
    exposure = seen_any6,
    fan = fan_yn,
    E1_Rank = "rank_1f6w__StarWars:EpisodeIThePhantomMenace",
    E2_Rank = "rank_1f6w__StarWars:EpisodeIIAttackoftheClones",
    E3_Rank = "rank_1f6w__StarWars:EpisodeIIIRevengeoftheSith",
    E4_Rank = "rank_1f6w__StarWars:EpisodeIVANewHope",
    E5_Rank = "rank_1f6w__StarWars:EpisodeVTheEmpireStrikesBack",
    E6_Rank = "rank_1f6w__StarWars:EpisodeVIReturnoftheJedi") %>% 
  select(c(1,2,3,10,11,12,13,14,15)) %>% 
  filter(exposure == "Yes") %>% 
  drop_na()

View(wide)
```

```{r}
best <- wide %>% 
    mutate(best = case_when(
      E1_Rank == 1 ~ "The Phantom Menace",
      E2_Rank == 1  ~ "Attack of the Clones",
      E3_Rank == 1 ~ "Revenge of the Sith",
      E4_Rank == 1 ~ "A New Hope",
      E5_Rank == 1  ~ "The Empire Strikes Back",
      E6_Rank == 1 ~ "Return of the Jedi"))

View(best)
```

```{r}
ggplot(best, mapping = aes(best))+
  geom_bar(fill = "blue")+
  coord_flip()+
  labs(title = "What's the Best 'Star Wars' Movie?",
       subtitle = "Of 471 respondents who have seen all six films")
```

```{r}
ggplot(single, mapping = aes(shot_first))+
  geom_bar(fill = "blue")+
  coord_flip()+
  labs(title = "Who Shot First?",
         subtitle = "According to 834 respondents")
```
